checked_sources: Independent F_3 reproduction: enumerate the four entries in {0,1,2}, test the four ordered basis pairs by coordinate multiplication and permutation, then take matrix ranks modulo 3.
correctness.rationale: Write d_i for the coefficient of e_i in R(e_i). On (e_i,e_i) the left side is Σ_j a_j r_{ji}²e_{σ(j)} and the right side is 2a_i d_i R(e_{σ(i)}). The basis vectors on the left are independent and every a_j is nonzero, so d_i=0 forces the entire input column to vanish. The e_{σ(i)} coefficient gives d_i²=2d_i d_{σ(i)}. In characteristic two there is no active column. Otherwise an active d_i propagates by d_{σ(i)}=d_i/2, giving exactly the 2^{|C|}=1 condition, impossible in characteristic zero. A scalar on each resonant cycle extends by this recurrence; the diagonal map then verifies the identity on equal basis pairs and trivially on unequal ones. This proves exactly 2^r supports and an r-dimensional diagonal locus over the stated field, with resonance equivalent to order divisibility in odd prime characteristic. Natural-basis changes are monomial because the independent squares force distinct natural-basis columns to have disjoint coordinate support. In the unweighted single resonant cycle, v=Σ e_i has v²=v and v e_j=e_{σ(j)}; for λ_{σ(i)}=λ_i/2 the map e_i↦λ_i v verifies the identity on all basis pairs, yielding rank one while the same diagonal coefficients yield rank n. An independent direct enumeration tested all 81 maps for the unweighted two-cycle over F_3, obtaining ranks 0,1,1,2,2, with both inputs active for every nonzero solution.
residual_risks: The frozen checker checks the recurrence primarily on the diagonal and its ranks_nondiagonal output column counts nondiagonal maps rather than computing their ranks. The general proof, not that finite output, supplies the column-support equivalence; the independent F_3 check explicitly computed ranks.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: An invertible weight-zero Rota–Baxter map has a derivation as inverse, explaining the reciprocal profile. In general the two recurrences are reciprocal, not literally equal along the same arrow; the comparison sentence in RESULT.md:55 should be read as common resonance. Derivation results alone do not restrict the supports of singular Rota–Baxter maps.

evidence: The October Finding gives the complete diagonal rank-two and rank-one lines for the unweighted two-cycle in characteristic three. The November two-dimensional example has e_2²=e_1+e_2 and a characteristic-31 branch.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The first is exact coverage of the corresponding case, not of arbitrary weighted cycles, fields and dimensions. The second has a nonmonomial structure matrix and is outside scope. A finite table alone cannot give the all-field necessity theorem.

originality.rationale: The supported distinction is the all-operator active-input support theorem for every weighted permutation evolution algebra over every field. Derivations already give the resonance parameter and the invertible diagonal profiles after reciprocal correspondence; the earlier characteristic-three unweighted two-cycle record also gives the exact two branches for that instance. Neither entails the all-operator necessity, including singular nondiagonal maps on arbitrary weighted cycles. The E^2=E graph-classification question does not supply that conclusion. The novelty judgment is limited to this support classification and its general attainability, not to the recurrence as a numerical cycle condition or the isolated two-cycle example.
residual_risks: Historical priority beyond the inspected graph, derivation, and Rota–Baxter sources is not established.

value.rationale: Active inputs are a natural exact invariant of a graph-based operator problem. The theorem turns the nonlinear equations into a necessary support rule applying even to singular and nondiagonal solutions, realizes every permitted support, and gives an exact count and field dependence independent of all nonzero structure weights. This is useful structural information without claiming the full operator variety; the rank-one construction shows why the distinction matters.
residual_risks: No claim of classifying arbitrary weights, structure matrices outside monomial type, or all off-diagonal ranks.
